title: From 100 to 260 AI-Assisted Games. We're Almost at 300!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
First of all, another huge thank you to everyone who's been submitting their games to VibeToplist!

Not too long ago, I shared a milestone here when we were approaching 100 game listings. The response from this community was incredible (like always), and I wanted to share a little update.

We've now reached 260 unique game submissions, and we're quickly approaching 300!

What started as a small side project dedicated to discovering AI-assisted and vibe-coded games continues to grow beyond my expectations. Organic traffic keeps climbing exponentially, more developers are finding their way to the platform, and the quality and ambition of some of these projects are genuinely impressive.

If you're working on an AI-assisted game yourself, you're still more than welcome to submit it completely free. The goal hasn't changed: help developers get discovered, attract new players, and provide a valuable SEO backlink to their projects.

I mean this from the bottom of my heart, AI-assisted and vibe-coded games are blowing up, and there has never been a better time to jump on this train than right now. I can see it from the quality of the games being released, the organic traffic on related keywords & playerbases on plenty of these indie projects.

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)

comments.author: ongix
comments.body:
I was actually thinking of doing this at some point so awesome you already went through the trouble. Looks nice

  
Are you going to have an upcoming section?

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body:
Thank you for your positive comment, I appreciate it. I believe there are still iterations possible regarding this concept. A similar Steam environment for example, but based on vibe coded and AI-Assisted games, or a video channel. Plenty more ideas to discover, so definitely still pursue your idea.

The upcoming are basically the ones tagged as: 'In Development' or 'Early Access'. All game submissions are tagged.

If you have any other questions, I am happy to answer them!
